plotEn:
In March, architect Yuri arrives in the town of Nagi, Okayama. Yuri is noticed by a middle school-aged boy named Keita, who brings up a portrait of her drawn by his best friend, the budding artist Haruki. Keita brings Yuri to her destination, the home of Yoriko, a sculptor and cow farmer who has recently moved back to Nagi from Tokyo. With the background of the Russian invasion of Ukraine, tensions are high in the town, which has a Japan Self-Defense Forces military base that holds constant live-fire exercises. It is revealed that Keita does not attend school because he only has Haruki as a friend, given that he moved here due to his father's service in the military. Yuri is in Nagi to reunite with Yoriko and be a model for her sculpture, the sister of her former husband, Masato, an architect based in Taiwan. Haruki's father arrives, a man named Yoshihiro Iguchi, who is the radio announcer for the town.
In the days following, the two boys bring Yuri around the town. Keita shows her his sketches of birds, and asks her whether or not she is in a romantic relationship with Yoriko, which she denies. He tells her that he is going to move in two weeks, as his father is being transferred to another military base after five years at Nagi. Haruki brings her to the Nagi Museum of Contemporary Art, telling her that his widowed father is in love with her, and that she should marry him. While exiting the museum, they run into Keita, who is disappointed and runs away, as Haruki had promise
